role: secondary spatial site-template-resistant diagnostic; cannot replace or rescue the authoritative four-bay node-level TNC primary
predictor_definition: anchor_TNC - mean(anchor_TNC across the three frozen anchors within node)
complete_anchor_rule: exactly three complete distinct frozen anchors per included node
no_rescue: Do not move anchors after TNC assay or future outcome access.
Do not replace quantitative Braun-Blanquet with binary reappearance.
Do not use this diagnostic to rescue a null authoritative four-bay node-level TNC primary.
Do not retain a three-anchor node when any anchor fails authoritative TNC QC.
Do not replace a failed anchor with a different meter mark after future outcomes are known.

measurement_validity_gate.method_pilot_prerequisite: Authoritative TNC-v2 method pilot must pass its frozen analytical QC before the spatial diagnostic is eligible for ecological interpretation.
measurement_validity_gate.anchor_requirement: All three frozen q25/q50/q75 anchors must have anchor_tnc_qc_pass == true; a failed anchor makes the node ineligible.
measurement_validity_gate.no_imputation: Do not impute, borrow, or replace a failed anchor TNC value after future outcome access.
measurement_validity_gate.interpretation: The diagnostic is intended to compare biological reserve heterogeneity within a transect, not analytical-quality heterogeneity.
